name: kariera-job-scraper
postStartCommand: sudo chown -R claude:claude /home/claude/.npm-global && if [ ! -f /home/claude/.npm-global/bin/claude ]; then npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code; fi && sudo rm -f /usr/bin/claude && touch /home/claude/.claude/claude.json && ln -sfn /home/claude/.claude/claude.json /home/claude/.claude.json && if [ -n "$HOST_WORKSPACE_FOLDER" ]; then PROJECTS=/home/claude/.claude/projects; HOST_KEY=$(echo "$HOST_WORKSPACE_FOLDER" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/-/g'); CONTAINER_KEY=$(echo "$PWD" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/-/g'); if [ "$CONTAINER_KEY" != "$HOST_KEY" ]; then mkdir -p "$PROJECTS/$HOST_KEY"; if [ -d "$PROJECTS/$CONTAINER_KEY" ] && [ ! -L "$PROJECTS/$CONTAINER_KEY" ]; then mv "$PROJECTS/$CONTAINER_KEY"/* "$PROJECTS/$HOST_KEY"/ 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$PROJECTS/$CONTAINER_KEY" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; ln -sfn -- "$HOST_KEY" "$PROJECTS/$CONTAINER_KEY"; fi; fi && pip install --user --break-system-packages -e /kjs
